anchor: Wave 2 Track P Phase P.1 — country-level tax + social contribution rates
convention: All rates as decimal (0.21 = 21%). cit = corporate income tax effective rate (combined federal + average state where applicable). employer_social = employer social contribution rate as % of gross payroll. Country-level approximation only — regional/state variations belong in Track P.3 (Pro feature). Sources cross-referenced from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries 2024 + OECD Tax Statistics + national tax office snapshots.
review_status: Initial draft. Rates change annually — refresh routine should run every January.
disclaimer: These rates are planning estimates only — not tax advice. Actual liability depends on business form, deductions, incentives, regional surcharges, and treaty positions.

US.notes: Federal corporate tax 21%; state varies 0-9.99% (CA 8.84%, NY 7.25%, TX 0%). Employer social = FICA 7.65% (Social Security + Medicare). State unemployment adds ~1-2% typically.

GB.notes: Main rate 25% (small profits rate 19% for profits under £50k). Employer NIC 13.8% on earnings above secondary threshold.

CA.notes: Federal CIT 15% + provincial average ~11.5% (Ontario 11.5%, Quebec 11.5%, BC 12%). CPP + EI employer ~11.5% combined.

DE.notes: Combined corporate tax: federal CIT 15% + Solidaritätszuschlag 5.5% on CIT + trade tax average 14% = ~30%. Employer social contributions ~20% (pension 9.3%, health 7.3%, unemployment 1.3%, long-term care 1.7%).

FR.notes: CIT 25% (standard rate). Employer social contributions among highest in OECD ~42% (URSSAF + retirement + unemployment + family + accident).

IT.notes: IRES 24% + IRAP regional 3.9% average = ~27.9%. Employer INPS contributions ~30% of gross salary.

ES.notes: CIT 25% standard (15% reduced for new companies first 2 years). Employer social security ~30.5%.

PT.notes: CIT 21% + municipal/state surcharges (up to 9%). Employer social security 23.75%.

NL.notes: CIT 19% (first €200k) / 25.8% (above). Employer social ~19% (combined health, unemployment, pension).

BE.notes: CIT 25% (reduced 20% on first €100k for SMEs). Employer social security ~27%.

LU.notes: Combined CIT + solidarity surcharge + municipal trade tax average ~25%. Employer social ~13.5%.

CH.notes: Combined federal + cantonal CIT average 14.4% (Zug 11.85%, Bern 21%). Employer AHV/IV/EO + pillar 2 + UI ~7.7% (excluding pension).

NO.notes: CIT 22%. Employer national insurance ~14.1% (varies by zone).

FI.notes: CIT 20%. Employer social contributions ~19% (TyEL pension 17.4% + others).

DK.notes: CIT 22%. Employer social contributions ~1.2% (Denmark social system is mostly tax-funded, not employer-contribution). High effective income tax burden absorbed via personal taxes.

PL.notes: CIT 19% standard / 9% for small taxpayers. Employer ZUS contributions ~20.5%.

CZ.notes: CIT 21% (up from 19% in 2024). Employer social + health insurance 33.8%.

HU.notes: CIT 9% (one of lowest in EU). Employer social tax 13%.

SK.notes: CIT 21% (15% reduced for small entities). Employer social contributions 35.4%.

RO.notes: CIT 16%. Most employer contributions shifted to employee in 2018 reform; employer pays only 2.5% work insurance contribution.

BG.notes: CIT 10% (flat, one of lowest in EU). Employer social security ~19.3%.

HR.notes: CIT 18% standard / 10% reduced for SMEs. Employer health insurance 16.5%.

EE.notes: CIT only on distributed profits (20%); retained earnings untaxed. Employer social tax 33% + unemployment 0.8% = 33.7%.

LV.notes: CIT 20% on distributed profits only. Employer social ~23.6%.

LT.notes: CIT 15% standard / 0-5% reduced for small companies (up from 16% trend). Employer social mostly shifted to employee in 2019 reform; employer pays ~1.77%.

AU.notes: CIT 30% standard / 25% base rate entities (turnover under A$50M). Superannuation guarantee 11.5% (rising to 12% by 2025) + payroll tax ~5% average state.

NZ.notes: CIT 28%. Employer KiwiSaver matching ~3% + ACC levies ~1%.

JP.notes: Combined national + local enterprise tax ~30.5%. Employer health/pension/unemployment ~15.4%.

KR.notes: Combined corporate tax 9-24% progressive + local surtax = ~24.2% effective for medium firms. Employer 4 social insurances ~10.8%.

SG.notes: CIT 17% (with partial exemptions). Employer CPF contributions up to 17% for Singapore citizens/PRs.

HK.notes: Profits tax 16.5% (8.25% on first HK$2M). MPF mandatory 5% employer contribution.

IN.notes: CIT 22% (new regime) / 25% for older companies. EPF + ESI employer ~12-13%.

MY.notes: CIT 24% / 17% reduced for SMEs (first RM600k). Employer EPF + SOCSO + EIS 13.5%.

PH.notes: CIT 25% (20% for small corporations with net income under PHP 5M). Employer SSS + PhilHealth + Pag-IBIG ~9.5%.

CN.notes: CIT 25% standard / 15% high-tech / 20% small profit. Employer social insurance + housing fund ~40% (varies by city: Shanghai ~38%, Beijing ~41%).

BR.notes: IRPJ 25% + CSLL 9% = 34%. Employer INSS 20% + FGTS 8% + outras 0.8% ≈ 28.8%.

AR.notes: CIT progressive 25-35% (35% for income over ARS 100M). Employer social ~24.5%.

CL.notes: Partially-integrated regime 27% (small enterprise regime lower). Employer ~2.7% (Chile uses individual capitalization for pensions, no employer share).

CO.notes: CIT 35% (one of highest in LATAM). Employer social ~20.5%.

RU.notes: CIT 20% (rising to 25% in 2025 per recent reform). Employer social insurance 30% (capped at threshold).

IL.notes: CIT 23%. Employer national insurance ~7% (low employer side; Israel relies more on personal income tax).

SA.notes: Zakat 2.5% for Saudi shareholders / CIT 20% for foreign-owned. GOSI employer 12% (citizens) / 2% (foreign workers).

AE.notes: Federal CIT 9% (effective from 2023, on profits over AED 375k); 0% for qualifying free zone entities. Employer GPSSA 12.5% for nationals only; expat workforce no employer social.

ZA.notes: CIT 27%. Employer UIF + SDL ~2% (relatively low; income tax is the main personal burden).

NG.notes: CIT 30% (20% for small companies). Employer pension 10% + ITF + NHIS ≈ 11%.

KE.notes: CIT 30%. Employer NSSF + NHIF + housing levy ≈ 6%.

MA.notes: CIT 12-31% progressive. Employer CNSS + AMO + formation ≈ 20.7%.

AL.notes: CIT 15% (5% for small businesses). Employer social ~16.9% (pension 15% + health 1.7% + maternity 0.2%).

AD.notes: CIT 10% (one of lowest in Europe). Employer CASS 15.5%.

MC.notes: CIT 25% (only on companies with >25% non-Monaco revenue). Employer social ~36% (one of highest).

GE.notes: Estonian-style CIT — only on distributed profits (15%). Employer pension 2% + retained 2% withholding-style.

default_fallback.notes: Default fallback when country-specific rate not in table. Conservative estimate close to OECD average.
